sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: kasthUri thilaka nosalana - tOra muttina hAra padaka darisUvana
ettidAbhaya hastha davana - tanna bhaktara stutige hAraisi higguvana
charaNam 2 - nIla mEgha shyAmalaNa - megha lOla makara kuNDala dharisuvana
moolOka dhoLage chennigana - shri kamalAyathaksA vaikuNTa vallabhana
charaNam 3 - bhAnu kOTi tEja davana - bhava gnanarAs hige havya vAhanana
dhAna varadEya dalla Nana - muni mAnasa hamsan EndEnisi verEvana
charaNam 4 - thunga chathurbhuja dhavana - shubha mangaLa rEke angALa loppuvana
shrngAra kambU(hAra) kandharana - dhEva gAngEya pitha purandhara viTTalana
